metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Its heartwarming ensemble cast and optimistic tone perfectly capture the vibe of Ted Lasso and the workplace charm of Scrubs.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Features a fast-paced, witty ensemble dynamic that fans of Community and Scrubs will absolutely adore.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Its dense layering of smart, meta-jokes and dysfunctional family dynamics matches the clever writing of Community.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A masterclass in character growth and feel-good comedy that hits the same emotional and hilarious sweet spots as Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: A brilliant mockumentary sitcom that shares the heartfelt, chaotic family energy of Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: If you love the sci-fi absurdity of Rick and Morty and Futurama, you will enjoy the fast-talking, highly satirical spy antics here.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: Offers the wholesome family dynamic of King of the Hill combined with the comforting, witty animated style of The Simpsons.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary about vampires that blends the supernatural absurdity of Dirk Gently with the chaotic ensemble of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: An incredibly charming British pop-culture-obsessed comedy that serves as a spiritual precursor to the meta-humor of Community.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: This legendary British sitcom shares the tech-industry humor of Silicon Valley and the awkward, deadpan comedy of Peep Show.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A highly entertaining, low-stakes British game show that delivers pure comfort and laughs, perfect for fans of Gogglebox.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: Captures the chaotic, unfiltered, and deeply funny friendship energy found in It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia and New Girl.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A wonderfully queer, lighthearted pirate adventure that shares the heartfelt humor of Ted Lasso and the fun adventure of One Piece.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: The ultimate comforting background comedy that features an iconic ensemble, matching the easy-watching nature of New Girl.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A whimsical, deadpan musical comedy series that appeals directly to fans of quirky British/Commonwealth humor like Peep Show.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the co-creator of Rick and Morty, this animated alien sitcom delivers the same sci-fi madness and sharp comedic timing.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: A wildly fun, action-packed superhero comedy that captures the irreverent spirit of Fallout and One-Punch Man.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A heartwarming, laugh-out-loud Canadian sitcom that provides the cozy family comfort of King of the Hill.

metas.name: The Mighty Boosh
metas.description: A surreal, highly imaginative British comedy classic that will delight fans of Dirk Gently and Goodness Gracious Me.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A lovely, comforting British sitcom about historical spirits that blends the existential whimsy of The Good Place with cozy humor.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A warm, critically-acclaimed mockumentary that perfectly fills the comfort-comedy void left by Parks & Rec and New Girl.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: An easy-to-watch, hilarious workplace sitcom with great character dynamics, ideal for fans of Brooklyn Nine-Nine and Scrubs.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A high-energy, nostalgic teen comedy set in 1990s Northern Ireland that mirrors the chaotic youth energy of Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Reservation Dogs
metas.description: A charming and witty comedy-drama about Indigenous teens that matches the dry humor and heart of Brassic.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A delightful, pop-culture-packed comedy detective show that has the witty banter of Scrubs and the mystery of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Regular Show
metas.description: A brilliant, surreal animated series that starts with mundane tasks and escalates into cosmic chaos, perfect for Futurama fans.

metas.name: Adventure Time
metas.description: A wonderfully imaginative, colorful fantasy series that matches the adventurous heart of One Piece and the cleverness of Futurama.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: An incredibly sharp, fast-paced political comedy featuring ruthless banter that fans of Silicon Valley and Peep Show will love.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A fresh British comedy set in a world where everyone gets a superpower except the protagonist; matches the quirky charm of The Good Place.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A lighthearted, comedic love letter to classic sci-fi that captures the sci-fi adventure spirit of Doctor Who and Futurama.

metas.name: Loot
metas.description: A wealthy-out-of-water comedy starring Maya Rudolph that delivers the positive, uplifting vibes of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: Follows a group of cynical caterers in LA; its dry, deadpan, and deeply funny writing is perfect for fans of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the mind behind Scrubs and Ted Lasso, this is a highly underrated, tight-knit friendship hangout comedy.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A classic, cynical British sitcom about a misanthropic bookshop owner, matching the dark, dry humor of Peep Show.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: An incredibly wholesome, hilarious buddy comedy about low-budget ad men that matches the joyous energy of Community.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Created by the minds behind It's Always Sunny, this workplace comedy set in a video game studio hits the tech-humor beats of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: A bright, fast-paced, and endlessly optimistic comedy that matches the whimsical, rapid-fire joke style of Community.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A brilliant, short-lived satirical workplace comedy about an evil corporation, matching the clever writing of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Fresh Off the Boat
metas.description: A charming, nostalgic 90s family sitcom that delivers the same heart and laughs as Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Moone Boy
metas.description: A delightful, warm Irish coming-of-age comedy co-written by Chris O'Dowd, perfect for fans of Brassic and Malcolm in the Middle.
